## [1.29.0](https://github.com/dhrubonai/morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.29.0) (2026-10-11)

### Bug Fixes

* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** fixed crash on launch. Updated the Ijiami boot.dex and libhxpatch-ffdfe477.so to handle the newer Ijiami packer version used by MovieBox 4.0.03.0918.03. The old bootstrap could not decrypt the new payload, causing the app to crash immediately on launch. Telegram popup and coffee button preserved.

release_notes:
### Bug Fixes

* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** fixed manifest wrapping that prevented Morphe Manager from loading the v1.26.0 bundle. The Description field exceeded the 72-byte manifest line limit and wrapped, which Morphe could not parse. Shortened the description so the manifest stays on one line. Patch content is identical to v1.26.0 — supports MovieBox 4.0.03.0918.03.
